description: Owns expense claims and their approval lifecycle: creation, editing of rejected claims, manager approve/reject, and finance export to a payroll CSV. Also owns the minimal employee/manager directory needed to route a claim to its submitter's manager. Does not send email, does not integrate with a specific payroll vendor API, and does not store receipt bytes itself.
